## Summary

Describe the problem, the solution, and any related issue.

## Verification

List the build or checks performed, checks not performed, and known limitations.
For UI changes, include screenshots without personal or customer information.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and the Developer Certificate of Origin.
- [ ] My commits include my DCO Signed-off-by trailer.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under the applicable licenses.
- [ ] I preserved third-party licenses and attribution.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, signing keys, private logs, or personal data.
- [ ] I understand that contributions are voluntary unless separately agreed in writing and do not automatically grant compensation or business ownership.
